description: Our mission: Develop an intelligent platform that detects drought risks, predicts agricultural water stress, and recommends sustainable farming strategies using NASA Earth observation data and Artificial Intelligence.
summary:
Climate-Smart Agro-Climatic Forecasting, Water Budget Management & Post-Harvest Field Intelligence for Moroccan Agriculture

Built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge — Field Shift, AGRI-RADAR transforms Earth observation streams, real-time meteorological forecasts, and regional Moroccan agronomy into clear operational decisions for farmers across all 12 regions and 75 provinces/prefectures of Morocco.
details:
1. Overview & Satellite Intelligence Hub

  • Presents AGRI-RADAR's 4-stage Earth observation pipeline (NASA POWER, SMAP, GPM, MODIS, SoilGrids), national operational benchmarks (75 provinces, 7 weather hazard classes, daytime solar pumping focus), and a guided 4-step workflow from pre-planting risk screening to post-harvest dataset validation.

2. Analyze Farm (Pre-Planting Decision Engine)

Allows farmers or agronomists to evaluate a plot before sowing:

  • Province & Interactive Plot Map (PlotLocationMap): Selecting any of Morocco's 75 provinces automatically centers an interactive Google Map (@vis.gl/react-google-maps) where the user clicks or drags a pin to capture exact GPS coordinates (lat, lng), automatically filtered against regionally suited crops.
  • 7-Class Agro-Weather Hazard Screening: Evaluates target planting dates (+7 days to +3 months) using Open-Meteo live forecasts (or regional seasonal simulation fallback) into 7 operational hazard classes: Wildfire, Drought, Heatwave, HeavyRain, Thunderstorm, Fog, and Normal.
  • Drought Risk, Crop Suitability Score (0–100) & Water Requirement: Computes overall drought exposure, suitability index gauge, and total seasonal crop water requirement (m³ and m³/ha).
  • Water Requirements Simulator: Estimates daily crop water need (mm/day), net deficit (mm/day), gross irrigation requirement (m³/day), 7-day volume (m³), and irrigation system efficiency (drip 90%, sprinkler 78%, surface_flood 58%, rainfed 85%).
  • Water Budget — Seasonal Water Sufficiency: Compares the farmer's available seasonal water reserve (either declared directly in m³ or auto-estimated from declared availability tier) against gross seasonal demand and effective rainfall credit, outputting a clear completion verdict (Sufficient to Finish Season, Tight — High Deficit Risk, or Insufficient for Full Area), seasonal surplus/deficit (m³), coverage percentage (%), max viable acreage (ha), and mitigation advice.
  • Solar Daytime Irrigation Schedule: Generates stage-by-stage irrigation intervals (Establishment, Vegetative, Flowering/Critical, Maturation) tailored to soil drainage, precipitation credits, and daytime photovoltaic solar pumping windows.
  • Best Planting Window (12-Month Calendar): Automatically evaluates all 12 months for the chosen crop, Moroccan climate zone, cultivation mode (open_field vs greenhouse), irrigation method, water availability, and soil type, classifying each month into Favorable (≥ 70%), Moderate (45%–69%), or Unfavorable (< 45%) and highlighting the highest-scoring contiguous planting window.
  • Best Plant Prediction: Recommends the best-adapted local crop with seed/plant quantity estimates, predicted yield (t/ha and total tonnes), growth cycle, optimal soil texture, and resilience summary.
  • Branded A4 PDF Report: Generates multi-page vector PDFs (jsPDF) featuring the AGRI-RADAR brand identity, embedded satellite/roadmap Zone Map Snapshot, visual Water Budget card, 12-month Best Planting Window color calendar grid, irrigation tables, and full Arabic/RTL, French, and English typography support.

3. Field Follow-Up (Post-Planting Monitoring)

  • Designed for follow-up inspections from J+7 onward after sowing.
  • Combines province, exact GPS plot pin, crop, days after planting, observed phenological stage, and observed field symptom (leaf yellowing / chlorosis, wilting / heat stress, fungal spots / mildew, waterlogging, salt crust, pest damage, or healthy).
  • Generates prioritized corrective field actions, adjusted solar watering notes, warning signs, next check-in date, and a dedicated Post-Planting Diagnostic PDF Report with embedded Zone Map.

4. Harvest & Season Review (Ground-Truth Dataset Builder)

  • Collects post-season farm reality: actual planting & harvest dates, actual total harvest (tonnes), total seasonal water consumed (m³), detailed agricultural expenses (MAD), observed biotic/abiotic challenges, farmer notes, and explicit farmer consent for dataset inclusion.
  • Computes automated KPIs (real yield t/ha, water productivity kg/m³, total expenses MAD, cost per hectare MAD/ha, cost per tonne MAD/t, actual cycle duration in days).
  • Runs automated validation checks (date chronology, yield range plausibility vs agronomic benchmarks, water efficiency sanity, cost bounds, and consent check) assigning a Validated or Needs Review badge.
  • Supports Season Review PDF export (with Zone Map snapshot) and Structured CSV Dataset export (UTF-8 with BOM for Excel compatibility, strictly exporting consented/anonymized field records to improve future model calibration).

5. Agri-Advisor AI Assistant

  • Contextual agricultural advisor powered by Google Gemini (@google/genai) via the server-side /api/chat proxy.
  • Automatically inherits the active session's parcel context (province, exact GPS coordinates, crop, area, soil, irrigation, weather hazard class, drought risk, suitability score, and post-planting symptoms) while staying strictly scoped to Moroccan agronomy, irrigation, climate risk, and crop health.

6. Farmer-Friendly UX & Accessibility

  • Trilingual Switcher (EN / FR / AR) with automatic dir="rtl" document switching in Arabic.
  • Interactive Technical Glossary Toasts: Hovering or clicking underlined technical terms (ET₀, Kc, SMAP, GPM, MODIS, Ressuyage, Water Budget, Best Planting Window, etc.) reveals a plain-language explanation toast in the farmer's chosen language.
